title: First-push-green counts force-pushed heads
body:
Source: lane report for f46630c (t-azqbx43): `krn ledger --first-push-green` reads PR commits, so a head replaced by force-push is invisible; since 04e6b9e ship rebases and force-pushes when the base moved, and lanes force-push after a 76 rebase, so a red first head can vanish and the share reads high (live 80.0%, 40 of 50).
Outcome: first-push-green counts every head that got a Check run for the PR (from the workflow runs of the PR branch, `gh run list --branch <head> --json headSha,conclusion,event`), including force-pushed ones, and the ledger prints the count of heads that came only from runs.
Why: the primary brain metric must not flatter the brain.
Proof: a test over a verbatim capture of a PR whose first head was force-pushed away counts it as not first-push-green.
Files: src/outcome/first-push-green.ts, test/outcome/first-push-green.test.ts, test/fixtures/first-push-green/
